subject: Brightline is going paperless - invoices by email starting December
text:
Dear Customer,

Starting December 1, Brightline will stop mailing paper invoices. All invoices and statements will be emailed as PDFs from invoices@brightlineoffice.com to the billing contact on your account. If you'd like invoices sent to a different address (for example an AP intake mailbox), just reply with the address.

How you pay us is not changing.

Thank you for helping us cut paper waste,
Brightline Office Supply
label: ordinary
note: Invoice-delivery method change, not payment method.
